title: From the Laboratory to Real-World Application: Evaluating Zero-Shot Scene Interpretation on Edge Devices for Mobile Robotics

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative error analysis of zero-shot scene descriptions generated by Vision Language Models (VLMs), specifically evaluating the model's tendency to hallucinate actions based on the mere presence of certain objects (e.g., predicting a person is writing just because a whiteboard is present) and its bias toward confusing closely related actions.
